note: Build the index without blocking reads or writes. CONCURRENTLY only takes a SHARE UPDATE EXCLUSIVE lock, so the app's INSERTs and SELECTs keep running. (customer_id, id) lets GET /customer's 'WHERE customer_id = $1 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 10' read 10 index entries with no sort. IF NOT EXISTS: the live database already has this exact index, so on that database this step changes nothing. No rows are touched either way.
Check that the index is valid and leads with customer_id. A failed concurrent build leaves an INVALID index behind, and IF NOT EXISTS would skip it silently, so stop loudly if that happened.
